comment: The document's only detailed worked example involving LOINC treats it purely as the downstream target of a concept map from a SNOMED CT concept (271649006 → LOINC 8480-6), rather than as a primary code system with its own structure (panels, question/answer conventions, document and observation typing). This may understate LOINC's role as a first-class terminology.
